subjectTemplate: An IFPA administrator has corrected something on {clubName}
bodyTemplate:
Hi {leaderName},

You co-lead {clubName} on footbag.org, and an IFPA administrator has corrected {whatChanged}. Nothing else about the club has changed, and this does not affect your own membership.

Administrator's note:
{note}

You can see the club's page by logging in to footbag.org and opening your club. If you believe this was corrected in error, submit a contact request from your profile edit page.

International Footbag Players Association
